vwap.beginner_summary: The average price weighted by trade volume today. Prices above this line indicate buyers are currently in control.
vwap.risk_tip: Buying far above the average price increases your risk of buying at the top.

rsi.beginner_summary: Measures how fast a stock is rising or falling on a scale of 0 to 100. Over 70 indicates potentially overheated; under 30 indicates heavily sold.
rsi.risk_tip: Oversold does not guarantee an immediate bounce. In strong downtrends, prices can stay oversold for weeks.

bollinger_bands.beginner_summary: An envelope showing where prices trade 95% of the time. Prices touching the outer bands are at statistical extremes.
bollinger_bands.risk_tip: When bands contract tightly, an explosive price breakout in either direction is usually imminent.

macd.beginner_summary: Shows the relationship between two moving averages of prices to spot trend changes.
macd.risk_tip: Can be unreliable in choppy, sideways markets, causing false signals.

atr.beginner_summary: Measures how much the stock price typically moves in a day, helping set stop losses.
atr.risk_tip: High ATR means high volatility and larger potential losses if trades go against you.
